# Fixture provenance

`listing-november.html` is an unchanged copy of the public EP listing already
present in `deliverables/ep-2026-11-12-batch/votes.html` in the user's workspace.
The accompanying batch manifest records `checkedAt` as
`2026-11-08T20:19:06.534546+00:00` and its catalogue URL as
`https://www.europarl.europa.eu/plenary/en/votes.html`.

It advertises 11 unique voting-list XML candidate paths via PDF/DOCX links.
It is saved-page evidence for discovery, not a fresh live response.

WordML used in unit tests is deliberately synthetic and declared inline. No live
WordML response was obtained in the implementation session, so those tests must
not be described as real-file XML parser validation.
